host: Local file bundle in the actual integrated browser

configuration.cohorts: Fixed buckets 2, 7, ... 97; below 50 is A/v1, otherwise B/v2.
configuration.initialAccount: Schema 1, 1000 synthetic credits, zero tickets, no effect keys.
configuration.operation: One credit for one ticket, retried with the same operation key.
configuration.round: One simulated minute, not a measured wall-clock soak.

publicationBinding.note: The serialized publisher assigns and remotely verifies the implementation SHA and annotated tag after these files are committed. The receipt and final result bind this evidence to those exact identifiers; no self-referential commit SHA is fabricated here.

coverage: Stable cohorts during a sustained 50/50 experiment
Equivalent canonical state and shared idempotency effects
Deliberate convergence needing a new current-target observation
Unknown missing observations and lagging-route failure
Historical adverse outcomes retained after later passing probes
Actual keyboard operation, Reset and scope boundaries

tdd.runner: node:test with node:assert/strict; no dependencies, install or mock-browser runner

red.cause: Loadable no-op behavior stub lacked the specified behavior. This is actual runner output, not missing tooling/imports, fake red, or a browser mock.

iacStep.reason: Self-contained resource-free lesson. C001 approves design/local implementation only, not cloud, IaC generation, identity registration, deployment or expenditure.

tdd.implementationAndRefactor: Pure immutable behavior engine plus local HTML/JS/CSS controller. Refactored the fixed cohort rule to derive both cohort and version directly from the stable bucket; existing tests remained green.

green.scope: 24 behavior tests and 8 static bundle-contract checks

metadataIntegrity.scope: JSON identities, retained workflow SHA-256 values and ordering, actual red/green summaries, redacted output paths, and exclusion of the hidden-page timeout.

tdd.paths: Workspace prefixes in actual runner output are redacted to <repo>; other evidence paths are repository-relative. Whitespace-only TAP line padding was stripped from the retained real red output because the publisher rejected trailing whitespace before any commit; assertions, counts and timings were not altered.

verifierResult.note: The educational guard correctly exposes failed/unknown users and refuses false convergence. This is not a claim that those negative users succeeded.
verifierResult.heldSplit: Twelve observed passing rounds still report not complete migration.
verifierResult.convergence: A 100% request retains the prior 10/10 sample and unknown current-target outcome until a separate complete observation.
verifierResult.negativeRetention: Unstable/incompatible/lagging failures and missing unknowns remain in history, including after later passing samples.

userImpactResult.healthySplit: 20 synthetic observations per round; 10 v1 and 10 v2; compatible cumulative state and one effect per transaction; not all users migrated.
userImpactResult.healthyConvergence: After 12 held rounds plus one convergence observation, all 20 fixture users show v2, schema 1, credits 987/987, tickets 13/13 and effects 1/1.
userImpactResult.unstableAssignment: Round 2 fails for all 20 switched users; round 3 returns but does not erase the failure.
userImpactResult.incompatibleState: 10 v2 users fail with schema 2 and two effects per retried operation; not successful migration.
userImpactResult.missingObservation: 10 observed v1, 9 observed v2 and 1 unknown; no invented state/effect for u20.
userImpactResult.laggingConvergence: Desired 100%; observed 1 v1 and 19 v2; failed convergence remains failed after a later all-v2 sample.
userImpactResult.missingConvergence: 19 observed v2 and 1 unknown; convergence is unknown.

cleanupResult.result: Defaults restored, local rows/history cleared, keyboard focus returned to hold-rounds on Reset; final reload remained unobserved.

limits: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
No credentials, management calls, live traffic, cloud resources, identity registration or expenditure.
No framework is adopted. Node 22 is test tooling and does not validate the proposed Node 24/Express production design.
The deliberately balanced fixture is not a claim that configured 50/50 weights guarantee a balanced real observed sample.
No native B-S004 proof, full D-S004 acceptance, real-user migration, version retirement or reliability guarantee.
One Kano unit A-S004 is retained. Worker publication is not empirical acceptance or awarded credit.
